items.question: What are the two defining qualities of the contemplated object?
premises: The object is completely full of all delight.
It is the cause of all bewitching.
items.inference: The contemplated object both fulfills delight and causes universal enchantment.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the contemplated object is not stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: It is completely full of all delight and is the cause of all bewitching.
